role.altitude: The controller stops preparing the close and starts designing it. They own the tie-out rules, materiality thresholds, the prompts for drafted commentary and the audit trail. Models write first drafts, and nothing posts or leaves the company until the tie-out passes and the controller approves.
reach: FP&A Analyst: the forecast and scenario model, so advice and forecast run on one governed dataset
Payroll Specialist: AFAS payroll runs and the loonaangifte, so payroll-to-ledger checks run before payroll is final
Compensation and Benefits Specialist: pension and insurance scheme data, to budget benefits from the headcount plan
Accountant: the close checklist and journals, to move tie-out queries into code both maintain
skills_to_grow: Writing tie-out and reconciliation rules as SQL or Python checks on the AFAS extract
Reviewing model-drafted commentary and memos against the numbers, and logging that review for the auditor
Setting materiality thresholds and running exception queues
Scenario modelling with FP&A on a shared data platform
AI governance basics: AVG/GDPR for payroll and health data, logging prompts and outputs so the auditor can rebuild them
role.ambitious_version: Close the month in three working days and refresh a 13-week cash and P&L forecast every week. Every number the MT sees traces to an AFAS line through logged tie-outs, and the controller uses the freed days for margin advice per site (Rotterdam, Tilburg, Venlo) and per customer.

tasks.short: Advise the MT and Finance Director on financial goals, policies and actions using actuals, forecasts and scenarios.

steps.what: Pull actuals, forecast and KPIs from AFAS and Power BI into Excel
Analyse variances, margins per site and scenarios (flex volume, fuel, CAO raise)

loop.input: variance table above materiality threshold with account and site
loop.output: short flux commentary per variance with likely drivers
loop.check: every figure in the text is matched by code against the variance table; unmatched numbers block the draft
loop.stop: one draft per variance, one retry on a failed check, then the line is left blank for the controller
loop.why_not_simpler: the variances and scenarios are code; turning them into readable drivers needs free text that templates handle poorly

steps.what: Write the advice memo or MT deck with options and a recommendation

loop.input: variance analysis, scenario table and the question from the MT
loop.output: memo skeleton with figures, options and risks
loop.check: figures inserted by code from the dataset, not by the model; controller writes or edits the recommendation
loop.stop: one draft per request; if sources are missing the draft lists the gap instead of filling it
loop.why_not_simpler: the narrative changes per question; a fixed template covers the tables but not the argument

steps.what: Discuss advice with Finance Director and MT and agree actions

tasks.design: Replace the monthly Excel pack with a governed Power BI model on a nightly AFAS extract plus a scenario table maintained with FP&A. A small Python job drafts variance commentary and a memo skeleton with a model, inserting figures by code and logging prompt and output in SharePoint; the controller edits and presents.
tasks.previous_blocker: Data sat in AFAS, the agency portals and personal Excel files, and free-text commentary could not be generated reliably.
tasks.enabler_now: Cheap AI-assisted coding for the extract and scenario model, and models that draft decent commentary when figures are locked by code.
tasks.still_hard: Judging what matters for the business, timing of advice, and trust of the MT; Dutch site-level context the data does not hold.
tasks.human_edge: Knowing the MT, the sites and the customers, choosing which trade-off to put forward and carrying it in the room.

ambition.what: A monthly margin review per site and per top-20 customer instead of a quarterly one

tasks.altitude: The controller spends less time building the pack and more time with site managers on margin; they gain a standing slot to propose pricing and flex-staffing policy.

reach.learn: The driver logic behind the forecast so advice and forecast use the same assumptions

evidence.claim: Models draft close commentary well on simple scenarios but people still judge and communicate
Judgement, not retrieval, is the bottleneck on full close tasks
Prompts and outputs must be stored so the auditor can rebuild an estimate
Power BI can host a scenario table next to the AFAS extract

assumptions: The nightly AFAS extract used for HR dashboards can be extended with GL and cost-centre data
FP&A keeps forecast drivers in a structured form
unknowns: Which management questions recur each month
Whether site-level P&L exists in AFAS cost centres
How the MT wants advice delivered
research_questions: Do the last 12 MT packs show recurring variance types that commentary drafts could cover?
How long does the controller spend building the pack versus discussing it?
Would the MT act on monthly site margin reviews, or is quarterly enough?

tasks.short: Manage pension, absence, WIA and liability insurance premiums, track rule changes and budget benefit costs.

steps.what: Collect premium notes, renewals and policy changes from insurers and pension fund

loop.input: PDF premium notes and renewal letters from a shared mailbox
loop.output: rows with insurer, policy, period, premium base, rate and amount
loop.check: amount equals base times rate within rounding; policy number exists in the register; failures go to a queue
loop.stop: one extraction plus one retry per document, then manual entry
loop.why_not_simpler: insurers and the pension fund send different PDF layouts with no API

steps.what: Reconcile premiums to AFAS payroll deductions and ledger accounts
Track changes in pension law (Wtp), WIA/WGA, ZW and premium rates

loop.input: new items from Belastingdienst, UWV, pension fund and broker sources
loop.output: short digest with impact on Noordhaven schemes and budget
loop.check: each item links its source; controller or C&B marks relevance
loop.stop: monthly batch, max 20 items, unclear items flagged not summarised
loop.why_not_simpler: the sources are free text and the impact depends on which schemes apply

steps.what: Build benefit and insurance budget from headcount and wage plan
Decide renewals and eigenrisicodrager choice with broker; sign

tasks.design: A shared mailbox feeds a Python job on the governed data platform that extracts premium notes into a premium register, reconciles them nightly against AFAS payroll deductions and ledger accounts, and queues differences. A monthly model digest of UWV, Belastingdienst and pension fund changes goes to the controller and C&B, and the budget is calculated by code from the FP&A headcount plan.
tasks.previous_blocker: Premium notes arrive as PDFs in many layouts and the reconciliation lives in a personal spreadsheet.
tasks.enabler_now: Reliable PDF extraction with checks, and fast coding of the reconciliation on the AFAS extract.
tasks.still_hard: Absence and WIA data are special category data under AVG/GDPR; access must stay aggregated and works-council consent may be needed for new processing of employee data.
tasks.human_edge: Negotiating with the broker, choosing to bear WGA risk or insure it, and weighing employee impact with HR.

ambition.what: A yearly, numbers-based review of eigenrisicodragerschap for WGA and ZW instead of rolling over the policy

tasks.altitude: The controller stops checking premium lines and reviews only exceptions; they gain a clear basis to propose insurance choices to the Finance Director.

reach.learn: Scheme rules and Wtp transition choices that drive cost

evidence.claim: Insurance and benefit summaries suit a model step with human review
Reconciliation and checks belong in deterministic code with a tie-out gate
Model output must be logged for audit

assumptions: Payroll deductions for pension and insurance are booked to separate AFAS ledger accounts
The controller, not C&B, owns premium budgeting
unknowns: Whether Noordhaven is eigenrisicodrager for WGA or ZW
How many insurers and which pension fund(s) apply
Whether the OR must consent under WOR art. 27 to the new processing
research_questions: How many premium differences were found last year and what did they cost?
Can the pension fund and broker deliver premium data in a structured file?
Does the OR see this as a new system processing personal data?

tasks.short: Check that AFAS payroll deductions are booked right, reconciled and paid to tax office and pension fund.

steps.what: Run payroll in AFAS and deliver payroll journal and loonaangifte
Reconcile payroll journal to wage tax, pension and social premium accounts
Tie loonaangifte and pension fund invoice to the ledger
Investigate differences: retro corrections, CAO changes, leavers

loop.input: difference lines with employee-level payroll mutations of the period
loop.output: likely cause per difference (retro, timing, rate, error) with the matching mutations
loop.check: proposed cause must reference mutations whose amounts sum to the difference; otherwise marked unexplained
loop.stop: one pass per difference, unexplained ones go to payroll
loop.why_not_simpler: causes are spread over mutation notes and free-text remarks that rules cannot match

steps.what: Approve wage tax and pension payment batch in Rabobank

tasks.design: AFAS keeps computing deductions; a scheduled SQL/Python job on the AFAS extract ties the payroll journal, loonaangifte, pension invoice and ledger to zero each run and shows breaks on a Power BI page. A bounded model step proposes causes for breaks from payroll mutations, and the Rabobank payment batch is released only when the tie-out is green and the controller approves.
tasks.previous_blocker: The checks were simple but nobody had time to code them, so they lived in Excel each month.
tasks.enabler_now: AI-assisted coding makes the tie-out job quick to build and maintain.
tasks.still_hard: Retroactive CAO changes and flex workers paid via agencies make some differences slow to explain; payroll data is sensitive under AVG/GDPR.
tasks.human_edge: Deciding whether a difference is acceptable, and owning the payment to the Belastingdienst.

ambition.what: A tie-out after every payroll run, including test runs, instead of once a month after the fact

tasks.altitude: The controller looks only at breaks and signs the payment; they gain a pre-payroll check point to stop a run with errors.

reach.task: Run AFAS payroll and file loonaangifte
reach.learn: Which mutation types cause most differences, to fix them at entry

evidence.claim: Nothing should post until bank, AR and AP tie to zero; the tie-out decides
Cash allocation and tax items need human approval with timestamped logs
AFAS Profit computes Dutch payroll deductions and the loonaangifte

assumptions: Payroll Specialist runs payroll in AFAS and the controller checks and pays
Payroll journal is available in the AFAS extract
unknowns: Number of payroll runs per month (weekly shift staff vs monthly office)
Which pension fund(s) and how invoices arrive
Current error rate in payroll-to-ledger reconciliation
research_questions: How many reconciliation breaks occurred in the last 12 months and what caused them?
Can the AFAS extract carry employee-level mutations with restricted access?
Does Rabobank allow a dual approval that fits a code-driven release?

tasks.short: Prepare monthly and annual statements, management reports, forecasts, budgets and filings like VAT, CBS and KVK.

steps.what: Extract trial balance, subledgers and close entries from AFAS
Tie out bank, AR, AP, payroll and intercompany between sites
Draft statements, management report and flux commentary

loop.input: statements built by code plus variance table
loop.check: numbers in text compared by code with the statements; draft blocked unless tie-out report is green
loop.stop: one draft and one retry per section, then blank for the controller
loop.why_not_simpler: tables come from code; explaining movements needs free text

steps.what: Roll up forecast and annual budget with FP&A
Prepare VAT return, CBS statistics and KVK filing input
Review and sign off with Finance Director and auditor

tasks.design: Move the close workbook to scheduled SQL/Python on a governed data platform fed by the AFAS extract and Rabobank CAMT.053 files: it builds statements, runs the tie-outs and publishes a Power BI close page. A bounded model step drafts commentary only after the tie-out is green; VAT stays in AFAS and the KVK SBR filing runs through filing software or the auditor, since AFAS cannot file it for large companies.
tasks.previous_blocker: The close depended on manual Excel links between AFAS, the bank and the agency portals, and commentary needed a person.
tasks.enabler_now: Fast AI-assisted coding of tie-outs and statement builds, and models that draft commentary when numbers are fixed by code.
tasks.still_hard: Dutch GAAP judgement (BW 2 Titel 9), estimates and provisions, and auditor acceptance; benchmarks are US GAAP only.
tasks.human_edge: Accounting judgement on estimates, materiality and disclosure, and signing for the numbers with the auditor.

ambition.what: A weekly flash P&L per site for site managers, available on Monday

tasks.altitude: The controller designs the close rather than running it: they own tie-out rules, thresholds and the commentary review, and they gain time to review the forecast with FP&A each month.

reach.learn: Which accruals recur and could be generated and rolled forward with review

evidence.claim: AI-using accountants closed the month 7.5 days faster in 79 small and mid-sized firms
On full close tasks the best model meets about 62% of criteria; judgement is the bottleneck
Accrual agents draft entries and people review and approve
The model drafts and the tie-out decides
AFAS cannot file SBR accounts with KVK for large companies
AFAS bank matching uses fixed rules on reference, IBAN and invoice number

assumptions: Noordhaven counts as a large company for KVK filing
Days to close today is well above five working days
unknowns: Current days to close and number of audit adjustments
Which CBS surveys Noordhaven must file
Whether an intercompany structure between sites exists
research_questions: Which close steps take the most hours today, by step?
Will the auditor accept code-based tie-outs and logged model drafts as evidence?
Can the AFAS extract be refreshed during the close days, not only nightly?
How did the last year's audit adjustments arise?
